references.text: The same principle that foreigners who wish to celebrate Passover must follow the same rules as the Israelites, with one law for both the native and the foreigner.
One and the same law shall apply to the foreigner and to the native, a fundamental principle of equality before the law.
Repeats the principle of one law and one statute for both the congregation and the foreigner living among them.
The same law for the native Israelite and for the foreigner regarding unintentional sins.
Passover shall be an eternal statute throughout all generations, the fundamental Passover regulation that also applies to foreigners.
The foreigner who lives with you shall be like a native, and you shall love him as yourself.
The commandment to keep Passover, which also applies to the foreigners living among the Israelites.
